normalization_plan.reason: The referral parent parameter only exists to index userData during mint accounting and should be folded into mint
The VIP flag parameter is a mint-only branch selector and carries no independent semantics
The token id parameter is normalized into the upgrade entrypoint that owns the corresponding accounting
The service id parameter is only a lookup key inside the buyService price resolution
The partner address is solely the subject of the distributePartnerFee settlement
User address parameters feed user-scoped reward accounting and are normalized into the reward payout function
The computed required payment is a mint-internal temporary that gates payment and fee splits
The accumulated referral bonus temporary is an internal split variable of the fee distribution routine
The resolved VIP local is a transient branch selector inside mint
The initial reward debt temporary is written directly into the new user record during mint
The derived token id temporary is only meaningful within the mint execution
The referral payout temporary is a claim-internal accumulator feeding the ETH transfer
The pool payout temporary is a claim-internal accumulator feeding the ETH transfer
The pool accumulator selection is a claim-local read used only for reward debt math
The read-and-zero temporary only exists to route the partner balance into the fee distributor
The entropy temporary is fully contained inside the pseudo-random generator
The pool storage pointer is a private helper temporary of the ePower increase routine
The receiver temporary exists only to perform the native ETH refund/payout external transfer
